children: New Delhi, Nov. 7 -- Muhurat trading 2026 | Samvat 2083 stock picks | Stocks to buy: The key benchmark indices of the Indian stock market recorded a sharp recovery last week, with the Nifty 50 index gaining 8.6% to close at 25,030.35 and Bank Nifty advancing to 59,086. The rally reflected a broader improvement in global risk sentiment, as hopes of a negotiated geopolitical settlement following the US midterm elections helped trigger a sharp correction in crude oil prices and encouraged a renewed flow of foreign capital into Indian equities. FIIs purchased a net Rs.45,960 crore during the week, while DIIs sold Rs.24,197 crore, shifting market leadership from domestic support to foreign-led accumulation.

After the solid gains of last week, stock investors must be busy finalising their stock shopping lists during the special Muhurat Trading session on Sunday, 8 November 2026. Marking the beginning of Samvat 2083, the special Muhurat Trading 2026 session will run from 2:20 PM to 3:30 PM.

Sumeet Bagadia, Executive Director at Choice Broking, believes that the Nifty 50 index closing above the crucial 25,000 signals a significant improvement in the short-term trend. The Choice Broking expert said that RSI jumped to 78.55, indicating strong bullish momentum but also an overbought market condition.

Speaking on the outlook of the Nifty 50 index at the beginning of Samvat 2083, Sumeet Bagadia said the 50-stock index has immediate support at 24,800-24,850, while resistance is seen around 25,130-25,200.

"Call OI is concentrated around 25,000-25,200 and Put OI around 24,800-25,000. The broader bias remains positive, although some profit booking or consolidation may follow the sharp rally," Bagadia added.
Regarding stocks to buy during the Muhurat trading session 2026, Sumeet Bagadia recommended these three Samvat 2083 stock picks: Adani Ports, Sun Pharma, and Kotak Mahindra Bank.
Here's the rationale, buying level, target and stop-loss regarding Sumeet Bagadia's stock recommendations for the Muhurat trading session 2026:

Adani Ports share has delivered an impulsive technical breakout from a multi-month symmetrical triangle pattern, accelerating into fresh territory to close with solid strength at Rs.1,936.60 after recording a lifetime high of Rs.1,948.90. On the daily timeframe, the counter underwent a protracted consolidation phase since June, repeatedly absorbing supply along the converging trendlines before producing a robust breakout candlestick backed by healthy market participation. The stock has established clear bullish alignment above all key short- and long-term moving averages (20, 50, 100, and 200 EMAs), confirming that the broader structural uptrend has resumed with strong conviction.

Sun Pharma shares have mounted an energetic rebound after retesting its primary ascending trendline support and the 50-week moving average zone, closing the week on a robust note at Rs.1,860.00. On the weekly chart, price action has maintained a structural pattern of higher lows along this multi-month rising trendline, with the recent pullback from lifetime highs near Rs.2,046.90 being absorbed right at the critical demand threshold. The stock has printed a solid weekly bullish candle that fully reclaims the short-term 20-week moving average, underscoring strong dip buying and a swift transition of momentum back into the hands of the bulls.

Kotak Mahindra Bank share has decisively breached its multi-month consolidation barrier near the Rs.445- Rs.452 zone, surging into uncharted territory to register a fresh lifetime high at Rs.480. On the daily chart, the stock resolved its prolonged accumulation base with an impulsive, wide-range bullish candlestick, underscoring dominant buying interest and strong institutional follow-through. The counter maintains clean bullish alignment across its key short- and long-term moving averages (20, 50, 100, and 200 EMAs), confirming that the broader structural uptrend is actively gaining momentum.
